result.title: Neural-DISCO: Source-Conditioned Counterfactual Editing of Neural Population Activity
result.summary: Understanding how neural activity encodes behavioral and sensory variables is a key challenge in systems neuroscience. This requires models that go beyond predicting activity from labels and instead support source-conditioned counterfactual editing: given a recorded source response, we should be able to edit one measured behavioral or stimulus label and predict how neural activity would change while preserving other observed labels and source-specific variability not explained by the labels. Here, we introduce \textbf{Neural-DISCO}, a disentangled representation learning framework for counterfactual modeling of neural activity. Neural-DISCO partitions the latent space into label-specific components, each associated with an observed behavioral or stimulus label, together with a residual latent that captures variability not supplied through observed labels. Across simulated and real neural recording datasets, we show that this structure enables selective editing of measured labels to generate counterfactual neural responses while preserving the remaining content of the original activity. Further, to gain insight into how behavioral and stimulus labels are encoded at single-neuron resolution, we pair this disentangled framework with feature attribution methods that identify which neurons are most important for each label. We find that disentanglement enhances the recovery of known functional cell roles in both synthetic and real data. Together, these results support Neural-DISCO as a framework for counterfactual modeling of neural activity and provide a practical interface for probing how neural populations encode behavior and sensory information. Code is available at https://github.com/TangLab-UBC/Neural-DISCO-neurips.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Neural-DISCO，把神经群体活动的潜空间分解为与各行为/刺激标签对应的分量和刻画标签外变异的残差潜变量，从而实现源条件下的反事实编辑，并用特征归因定位与各标签最相关的神经元。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「标签特异潜分量+残差潜」的结构与潜空间反事实编辑，可能为 LVR 中区分任务必要视觉信息与源特异无关变异、并以潜干预检验状态因果贡献提供借鉴，可供核查能否迁移到 VLM 内部状态分析。
